title: See Bryce Canyon’s hoodoos in winter
description: Look over Bryce Canyon Amphitheater from a rim viewpoint and take in rows of orange hoodoos against snow, evergreen trees, and blue winter sky. The shapes are striking in any season, but cold light and white ground sharpen their colors. You can choose a short overlook visit rather than a long, icy trail and still feel the scale of the formations.
teaser: See red rock spires framed by winter snow.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm winter road and overlook access. High altitude, cold and icy footing.
whyItMightDelightYou: The contrast is so vivid that a familiar desert scene begins to look entirely new.
